sources.snippet: DM0.5 is Dexmal's next-generation Vision-Language-Action model (VLA) for open-world robot control. It builds on the native embodied modeling approach introduced by DM0, with systematic upgrades for open-ended instructions, long-horizon tasks, dynamic disturbances, and multi-embodiment robot control. sources.title: DM05 Model Architecture | dexmal/opendm | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: The DM05 model is a Vision-Language-Action (VLA) model designed for robotic manipulation. It utilizes a dual-backbone architecture that combines a Vision-Language Model (VLM) for multimodal understanding with a specialized Action Expert for high-precision control. This page provides a high-level overview of the DM05 architecture, its configuration system, and its primary components.
